notes.title: Taiwanese coffee culture visual novel Sunny Café now available for consoles, PC!
notes.content:
[b]Hong Kong – March 27, 2024 –[/b] Independent developer and publisher Eastasiasoft Limited proudly announces today that Taiwanese-developed romantic adventure game Sunny Café has been released for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. The Steam release has also been updated with an English localization. Featuring interactive elements and a branching story, Sunny Café offers a dynamic and replayable experience beyond the limits common to its genre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/9e4ace0284183e97ac7c180fd9a5a54d43c6c46f.jpg[/img]
Sunny Café is a heartfelt visual novel adventure featuring a sweet romantic narrative, coffee brewing mechanics, Taiwanese cultural themes and a wide range of coffee-based knowledge to find and learn throughout the soothing gameplay experience. Players will engage in dialogue and make key decisions that directly impact story development, leading to multiple possible endings while getting to know a memorable cast of college students through beautifully illustrated event scenes.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/c61aed957f5d354ef9b9886d0fa118b1ec4fc0c0.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/c61aed957f5d354ef9b9886d0fa118b1ec4fc0c0.gif[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/cae5810af5c84efb291be6ee48c121cf966901fd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/cae5810af5c84efb291be6ee48c121cf966901fd.gif[/img][/url]

Sunny Café is originally developed by Taiwanese studio GameNobility and is published worldwide by Eastasiasoft Limited. Digital pricing is set at US$14.99/€14.99 with a launch discount available for select regions and platforms.

[h2]About Sunny Café[/h2]
On a summer afternoon, the thunder showers fall mercilessly and the bells in the café ring. A boy regains his senses, suddenly noticing a soaked girl standing at the door. Sunny Café is a tale of accidental encounters, acquaintances and eventual parting, a love text adventure game that uses Taiwanese coffee knowledge as a catalyst for this cycle of interactions and an analogy for life itself.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/c12773a5ab302ee6a8b4886366fee1e48d5f16d6.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/c12773a5ab302ee6a8b4886366fee1e48d5f16d6.gif[/img][/url]

Join a cast of Taiwanese college students and enjoy a visual novel steeped in local culture, customs and ideals. Learn how to make the perfect cup of coffee by selecting beans, grinding, choosing a filter and brewing skillfully. Select objects in the café to pick up vital bits of additional knowledge. Explore multiple endings affected by your conversations with people in a comfy setting, and perhaps guide a budding romance to full bloom!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/ceee5d5f563bd7c7ac7b9a88945596fea7524720.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/ceee5d5f563bd7c7ac7b9a88945596fea7524720.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Explore a deep narrative surrounding Taiwanese college students and a local café!
[*] Learn coffee brewing techniques and local customs.
[*] Select beans, grind, filter and brew through interactive sequences!
[*] Make key decisions and engage in conversation with a memorable cast.
[*] Discover multiple endings and guide a budding romance!
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/48f498080aa746c96f925c8cd090490de5493096.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40683332/48f498080aa746c96f925c8cd090490de5493096.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]About eastasiasoft[/h2]
Eastasiasoft Limited is an independent, Hong Kong–based developer and publisher of interactive entertainment specializing in video games and related media. Founded in 2007, eastasiasoft has published a diverse variety of titles in digital and physical format. Eastasiasoft is a licensed PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Xbox One publisher. Some of eastasiasoft’s recently licensed and published games are Mugen Souls Z, Sword and Fairy: Together Forever, Xuan Yuan Sword 7, Empire of Angels IV, Seven Pirates H, Moero Crystal H, Trigger Witch, Rainbow Skies, Rainbow Moon, and the Söldner-X franchise.

[h2]About GameNobility[/h2]
The slogan of Game Nobility is “Play for fun, play for knowledge”. This studio based in Taiwan makes delicate games steeped in knowledge. Players learn and have fun from their games simultaneously. GameNobility’s hope is to act as “Nobility” in the game industry and develop games in a responsible, honorable, leisurely and elegant way.  They believe that games are not just for fun. They are also the art that makes players slow down their lifestyles and enrich their lives.

notes.title: Mayflower Entertainment Releases Korean Version of 'Sunny Café' on Steam Today
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Romantic Text Adventure Game "Sunny Café" Korean Version Released on Steam on November 6th.
[*] In addition to thrilling love stories, it also offers a rich array of activities, including Taiwanese coffee history, culture, and mini-games.
[/list]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40683332/a9315e90e6e46606c743069c3cd39e16d6a4686e.jpg[/img]

Maple Flower Entertainment has announced the Korean language update for the text adventure game "Sunny Café," developed by Taiwan-based Game Nobility, following its initial release on Stove Indie. The game, released on Steam today (November 6th), revolves around the youthful romantic stories of main characters centered around a cafe, conveying coffee culture through in-game trivia.

[b]Game Features:[/b]

Unique Theme: While the game's theme is centered around a cafe and romantic stories, players can gain a proper understanding of coffee culture through game content. The focus is on conveying Taiwan's unique coffee culture and evoking memories of youthful romance during college days.

Diverse Gameplay: Through various and enjoyable mini-games within the game, players can learn about the coffee-making process, including bean selection, grinding, and more.

Hidden Background Items: Random items appear in the game's background, and clicking on them reveals nuggets of coffee-related trivia.
